top_choice_rationale: Adonis presents the strongest whole-oeuvre case on the supplied record: a sustained renewal of Arabic poetry through mythic imagination, formal fracture and dialogue with inherited forms, supported by a coherent conjunction of distinctive voice, intellectual depth and formal consequence. Translation and incomplete corpus access limit assessment of prosody and linguistic texture, but do not displace the documented breadth and durability of the project.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict requiring recusal is apparent from the supplied profile.
